The node note class does not know anything about the other nodes.
It only cares about its data and it is neighbor, so it doesn't care about other nodes that we have.
In the linked list and linked list class maintains the structure of the linked list itself.
It has a reference to the next first node in the linked list, which is called head, and the last node
in the linked list, which is called tail and typically contains operations that you need to perform
on the linked list itself, such as appending new node, deleting new node, finding a node.
So these all methods will be in the linked list class.
